sources.document_title: ALPS Alpine EC11L1525G01 product detail retrieval retry (issue #42)
sources.locator: Product-detail HTTP response; EC11 series category listing rows sub/01 through sub/04; control-test row for sibling EC11E15244G1 detail page
sources.evidence_extract: 2026-08-02 retry: https://tech.alpsalpine.com/e/products/detail/EC11L1525G01/ returns HTTP 403 across repeated attempts and header variants; the legacy https://www.alps.com/e/products/detail/EC11L1525G01/ URL redirects to https://tech.alpsalpine.com/e/info/detail/EC11L1525G01/, which also returns HTTP 403. Control test: the currently catalogued sibling EC11E15244G1 detail page returns HTTP 200 with the same client, so the block is specific to this part rather than a generic bot filter. No EC11L series entry appears in any of the four current encoder sub-category listings (sub/01: ec11e, ec11n; sub/02: ec12d, ec12e, ec18a; sub/03: ec05e, ec10e; sub/04: ec21a, ec28a, ec35a, ec35ah, ec35b, ec40a, ec45a, ec50a, ec60a, ec60b). The general EC11 series catalog PDF asset also returned HTTP 403 (access-denied XML body). Lifecycle state remains not source-confirmed; the exact model appears to have been withdrawn from the current online catalog structure.
